desc: Establish structural lemmas: all 1→0 flips precede all 0→1 flips, off flips sorted descending by C, on flips sorted ascending by C, only matched 1s may receive an optional off/on pair, and the optimal optional set of size k is the k largest matched-1 costs.
Implement the offline pairwise top-k evaluation described above, including input parsing, edge cases (empty O/I/M, already equal, ties in C), and 64-bit/Python integer handling.
Run the provided sample tests and small brute-force checks (N <= 8) to validate the formula and tie handling.
